description: Native FLUX 3 distilled BF16 reference pipeline, 16 steps, with its required local prompt upsampler. Uses the official gated checkpoint (requires a granted Hugging Face account and Controller token) and the upstream-tested vLLM 0.21 dependency family. Text-to-image at 1024 square; image editing is not exposed by this recipe. Estimated peak 100 GB includes the upsampler's 35% memory pool, DiT, text encoder, VAE and workspace. Physical Spark acceptance pending.
title: FLUX 3 Image Klein single Spark
